title: Stochastic Scalar Conservation Laws on Moving Hypersurfaces
summary: We establish the well-posedness of stochastic scalar conservation laws on moving hypersurfaces driven by Brownian motion. To handle the interaction between stochastic forcing and evolving geometry, we derive an Itô formula on moving surfaces and introduce the notion of generalized entropy solutions incorporating the relevant stochastic interaction terms.
